resources.string:
Nourishing opens your private PC diary inside the Android app. The PC and Tailscale must be running. Camera access is requested only for barcode scanning after you choose to scan. File uploads use files you select in the Android picker. Exports are staged privately until you save or cancel; files that cannot be removed are retried at the next launch. The Android export limit is 32 MiB per file. Browser reminders remain in Chrome.

Nourish Health Connect privacy

This companion reads only the Health Connect types that you select and grant: body temperature with recorded measurement location, body water mass, resting heart rate, HRV (RMSSD), oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, weight, height, body fat, blood pressure with recorded position and measurement location, blood glucose with recorded specimen and meal context, heart rate, sleep sessions, water, daily steps, active energy and exercise duration. A separate foreground export for biometrics, food nutrients and water asks for read and write permission for the selected type only when you press its grant button. Preview the exact local metrics, dates and time zone, then explicitly confirm the phone write. Blood pressure requires an unambiguous pair at the exact recorded time. Food and water use a disclosed one-minute interval for the recorded minute, not measured duration. Missing nutrients remain absent. Copied food and water diary events are distinct; native-source records are excluded. Nutrition read permission is used to verify your writes only. There is no automatic export or native deletion. Extended-history access is not requested. You can revoke read access in Health Connect at any time.

Foreground reads run only while this app is visible and cover at most 30 recent calendar days. A complete export is staged in app-private cache. It contains measurements, source app names, record IDs, modification times and interval timestamps. Exercise type, title and notes are included when recorded by the source. Sleep notes, exercise routes, laps and segments are omitted. App backup and device transfer are disabled. Clear staged data after use.

Direct transfer uses the exact private HTTPS Tailscale address that you enter. Check the connection to see the destination account before sending health data. Preview sends the staged export for comparison without changing records. Confirm reviewed import applies it. TLS certificate checks remain enabled. Redirects and automatic request replay are disabled. No login credentials or account tokens are stored in this app. Keep Tailscale connected on this phone and the PC.

Hourly background sync is optional and off by default. It requires a previously confirmed import destination, selected types and date-span consent, a supported Health Connect background-read feature, and Android background-read permission. After you explicitly enable it, new rolling exports are imported without per-run confirmation. Android controls timing; it is not an exact hourly alarm. Missing or revoked permissions prevent the corresponding reads. Stop hourly sync cancels scheduled work; a request already sent may have finished. Background staging uses a separate private cache and is removed after each attempt where possible.

The app has no analytics or public sharing endpoint. Save JSON uses the local Android document picker. A document provider can have its own upload and backup policy; choose on-device storage if you want the file to remain there. Saved documents remain outside app-private storage until you delete them.

Steps and active calories use Health Connect daily aggregation and its app priorities. Other records keep original source identities and can overlap. Sleep and exercise values are elapsed session durations, including possible awake time or pauses. Daily active calories may include workouts. Do not add them to older raw activity records or manual exercise totals. They remain a separate estimate and do not change Nourishing calorie targets. Missing records are unknown, not zero. Snapshot absence does not remove workspace records. Optional reconciliation can apply explicit native deletions after removal consent; manual and copied records remain separate.
Read recent health data, then review a direct transfer to your private Nourishing workspace or save a local JSON file.
Dates and times use your device\'s current zone, shown in the export. Select 1 to 30 recent calendar days. Keep the app visible while reading.

Sleep duration is the full session, including awake time. Available sleep stages keep the source timing and labels; gaps stay unknown. Exercise duration can include pauses. Steps and active calories use Health Connect daily totals. Active calories may include workouts; do not add them to raw activity or manual exercise totals. They do not change Nourishing calorie targets.

Use the checked workspace and date range. Match the local metric and time zone, then review. Imported or copied biometrics are excluded. Blood pressure pairs must share the exact time. Unrecorded context stays unknown; heart rate is a spot sample. Ordinary exports keep existing phone records. Review food or water removals under Corrections.

Food and water use one-minute intervals at the recorded time; duration and meal type are unknown. Incomplete nutrients, vitamin A (RAE), folate (DFE), vitamin E basis and unmatched nutrients are omitted and listed in the preview. Choose logged water for drinks only. Copied diary events are separate; native-source records are excluded.

Preview 1–30 days ending today. Enabling saves this type’s rolling window, mapping and account; edits to the form do not change it. Android controls timing. Keep the PC and Tailscale available. Existing copies are checked before writing; changed, missing or unreadable copies stop the run for review. Only changed source values are written. Manual export or re-enabling resets verification history. Stopping keeps phone records; a write already sent may finish.
